task_definition.task_name: DAS Channel Turning Point Detection in Channel Geometry

task_description.overview: Detect horizontal and vertical turning points in a fiber cable layout based on channel coordinates or low cross-correlation in waveform records.
steps: Load channel geometry coordinates (longitude, latitude, optional depth).
Compute angular changes between consecutive segments to identify geometric corners.
Optionally compute adjacent-channel cross-correlation on waveform data to detect signal anomalies.
Flag indices corresponding to significant horizontal and vertical turning points.

input_data.depth_info: boolean flag indicating whether to detect vertical turning points

task_definition.agent_prompt: Detect turning points in DAS channel geometry. Input: geometry array of [lon, lat, elevation], depth_info flag (True if the data contains elevation information). Compute corner points by analyzing coordinate angles and optionally low adjacent-channel waveform cross-correlation (consider use the `daspy.advanced_tools.channel.turning_points` function). Save the horizontal turning points and vertical turning points to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}. Finally, scatter plot the geometry and the turning points and save it to {result_figure}.
